verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Such examples, therefore, brethren, it is right that we should follow; since it is written, “Cleave to the holy, for those that cleave to them shall [themselves] be made holy.”
verses.modernizedText: Such examples, therefore, brethren, it is right that we should follow, since it is written, “Cleave to the holy, for those who cleave to them shall [themselves] be made holy.”

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: And again, in another place, [the Scripture] saith, “With a harmless man thou shalt prove thyself harmless, and with an elect man thou shalt be elect, and with a perverse man thou shalt show thyself perverse.”
verses.modernizedText: And again, in another place, [the Scripture] says, “With a harmless man you shall prove yourself harmless, and with an elect man you shall be elect, and with a perverse man you shall show yourself perverse.”

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Let us cleave, therefore, to the innocent and righteous, since these are the elect of God.
verses.modernizedText: Let us cleave, therefore, to the innocent and righteous, since these are the elect of God.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Why are there strifes, and tumults, and divisions, and schisms, and wars among you?
verses.modernizedText: Why are there strifes, tumults, divisions, schisms, and wars among you?

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Have we not [all] one God and one Christ?
verses.modernizedText: Do we not [all] have one God and one Christ?

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Is there not one Spirit of grace poured out upon us?
verses.modernizedText: Is there not one Spirit of grace poured out upon us?

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: And have we not one calling in Christ?
verses.modernizedText: And do we not have one calling in Christ?

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Why do we divide and tear in pieces the members of Christ, and raise up strife against our own body, and have reached such a height of madness as to forget that “we are members one of another?”
verses.modernizedText: Why do we divide and tear apart the members of Christ, raise up strife against our own body, and reach such a height of madness as to forget that “we are members of one another?”

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Remember the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, how He said, “Woe to that man [by whom offences come]!
verses.modernizedText: Remember the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, how He said, “Woe to that man [by whom offenses come]!

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: It were better for him that he had never been born, than that he should cast a stumbling-block before one of my elect.
verses.modernizedText: It would be better for him if he had never been born than that he should cast a stumbling block before one of my elect.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Yea, it were better for him that a millstone should be hung about [his neck], and he should be sunk in the depths of the sea, than that he should cast a stumbling-block before one of my little ones.”
verses.modernizedText: Yes, it would be better for him if a millstone were hung around [his neck] and he were sunk in the depths of the sea than that he should cast a stumbling block before one of my little ones.”

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Your schism has subverted [the faith of] many, has discouraged many, has given rise to doubt in many, and has caused grief to us all.
verses.modernizedText: Your schism has subverted [the faith of] many, discouraged many, given rise to doubt in many, and caused grief to us all.
